items.claim: Dusko is coming off his first win in 3 years where he took down Jose Medina twice and submitted him in the first round.
items.quote: He is coming off his first win in 3 years where he took down Jose Medina twice and then he submitted him in the first round.

items.claim: Robert Valentine is a creative striker who plots forward with low hands and plenty of spinning techniques.
items.quote: He's taking on Robert Valentine, a creative striker who's going to plot forward, low hands, and plenty of spinning techniques.

items.claim: Robert Valentine has powerful hands and a willingness to exchange, but he is ridiculously hittable.
items.quote: He's got powerful hands, a willingness to exchange, but he is also ridiculously hittable.

items.claim: Robert Valentine is the overall more durable guy in this matchup.
items.quote: I do think Robert's probably the overall more durable guy

items.claim: Marcin Tybura is a grinder with high volume who uses strikes to set up takedowns.
items.quote: Marcin Tybura is a grinder. He never quits. He's busy everywhere. His striking is just okay, and while he doesn't have heavyweight power, he does have volume. The strikes are really there to set up his takedowns.

items.claim: Marcin Tybura is at the advanced age of 40 and is somewhat durable.
items.quote: even though he's at an advanced age of 40, he's somewhat durable.

items.claim: Aleksandar Rakić is a dynamic striker who uses length and reach to out-technique opponents and mixes in kicks well.
items.quote: Aleksandar Rakić. He is a dynamic striker who uses his length and his reach to out-technique and out-decision his opponents. He mixes in kicks really well.

items.claim: Aleksandar Rakić has almost no chin and is riding a four-fight skid.
items.quote: almost no chin. He is riding a four-fight skid.

items.claim: Jan Błachowicz is a former light heavyweight champion with solid wrestling and heavy power.
items.quote: Jan Błachowicz, former light heavyweight champion of the world... He's a striker who hits incredibly hard. He's got solid wrestling.

items.claim: Navaho Sterling is a former kickboxer who is mobile, somewhat powerful, and does a good job investing in the body early.
items.quote: Navaho Sterling, a former kickboxer who is early in his MMA career... Navaho is pretty mobile. Navaho's somewhat powerful. He does a good job investing in the body early.
